//: JARVIS is a Python project: there is no TypeScript source and no build step.
The browser UI in gui/web/ is deliberate plain JavaScript so a Raspberry Pi
needs no Node.js toolchain. This config exists so that JavaScript gets
type-checked instead of going unchecked - `npx -p typescript tsc -b` validates
against the DOM types and reports real mistakes (typos, bad calls) as errors.
